description:
Pinnacle Pebblito

55 cm, “M” short for mmm

If it can be White industries, it is. BB, headset, crank, hubs w/ our fave brass extraction cap

Thomson x4 stem. 90mm pictured but I'll set up up with whatever you want. Thomson post.

Rene Herse Steilacoom Tires set up tubeless.

Sram force shifters and derailleur. Carbon, clutched…it's more than you need but it's what you want

Shimano br517…my fave mechanical brake ($/$$ toss up with klampers). Super strong, great tight lever feel. A set from my NOS personal stash.

Pebblito bars…fave shape for a gravel drop…that why we make em.

One of the last pebbies for maybe ever? The fancy tubes and carbon fork are real spendy for Monē bikes to justify…let's just be stoked this one exists now.
